hero.headline: Gunma Rafting & Outdoor Activities on the Tone River
hero.sub: World-class river rafting and canyoning in the heart of Gunma Prefecture.
hero.quick_answer: Dream Adventure is an outdoor tour operator based on the Tone River in Numata, Gunma, Japan, running whitewater rafting and canyoning trips. Rafting is open from age 6 and canyoning from age 12. A full-day combo of both is ¥10,000 for adults. The base is about two hours by car from central Tokyo, with free parking, and operates from April to October.

rafting.title: River Rafting
rafting.hero_headline: Tone River Japan: Gunma Rafting Adventures
rafting.season_title: Best Season for Tone River Rafting
rafting.season_desc: Rafting on the Tone River in Gunma runs from April through October. The spring snowmelt (April–June) offers extreme Grade 4 white water, while the summer and autumn months (July–October) provide calmer, scenic waters perfect for families and first-timers.
rafting.access_desc: 17 minutes by car from Numata Station. Free parking available at our base.
rafting.meta_desc: Experience river rafting on the Tone River in Gunma, Japan. 17 minutes from Numata Station. Book your adventure today.
rafting.hero_sub: Ride the Tone River with expert guides. Suitable for beginners to experienced paddlers.
rafting.age_rule: Ages 6 and up. Children aged 6–17 qualify for the child rate.
included_items: All safety equipment (wetsuit, helmet, life jacket, paddle)
rafting.quick_answer: Dream Adventure runs guided whitewater rafting on the Tone River in Numata, Gunma, about two hours from central Tokyo. Departures are at 9:00, 11:30, and 13:30, and trips are open to ages 6 and up. Adult ¥6,000, child ¥4,000, including life jacket and helmet rental, a guide in every boat, and free parking.

canyoning.hero_sub: Descend through pristine mountain canyons with our expert guides.

canyoning.quick_answer: Dream Adventure runs guided canyoning trips in the valleys around Numata, Gunma. Descents include natural rock slides, waterfall jumps, and swimming through canyon pools. Trips are open to ages 12 and up. Adult ¥6,000, child ¥4,000, including equipment rental and a guide on every descent.

items.q: Where can I go whitewater rafting near Tokyo?
items.a: Dream Adventure runs whitewater rafting on the Tone River in Numata, Gunma, about two hours by car from central Tokyo. The Tone is one of the Kanto region's main whitewater rivers, running from the spring snowmelt through autumn. Departures are at 9:00, 11:30, and 13:30, and there is free parking at the base.

items.q: What is the minimum age for rafting in Japan?
items.a: At Dream Adventure, rafting is open from age 6 and canyoning from age 12. Children aged 6 to 12 pay the child rate of ¥4,000 for rafting. A guide rides in every boat and adjusts the route to the day's water level, so the trip works for families and first-time paddlers.

items.q: Can I do rafting and canyoning on the same day in Japan?
items.a: Yes. Dream Adventure offers a full-day combo of rafting and canyoning for ¥10,000 for adults and ¥6,000 for children, which costs less than booking the two separately. Because canyoning has a minimum age of 12, the combo is open to ages 12 and up.

items.q: When is the best season for rafting in Japan?
items.a: Dream Adventure operates from April to October. April through June has the highest water from snowmelt and the strongest rapids; July and August have warmer water that suits families with children; September and October are calmer, with autumn colours through the valley.

items.q: How much does rafting cost in Gunma, Japan?
items.a: At Dream Adventure, rafting is ¥6,000 for adults and ¥4,000 for children, and canyoning is the same. A full-day combo of both is ¥10,000 for adults and ¥6,000 for children. All prices include equipment rental and a guide. A riverside BBQ can be added and is paid on site.

items.q: What should I bring for a rafting trip in Japan?
items.a: Please bring a swimsuit, a towel, and a change of clothes. Life jackets, helmets, and wetsuits are fully included in the tour price, so you do not need to bring your own specialized equipment. For footwear, please bring water-friendly shoes or old sneakers that you do not mind getting wet. For your own security, please do not bring valuable items or wear them during the activity, as they can easily be lost in the river.

Yes, we have English-speaking guides available to ensure you have a safe and thrilling experience on the river. All of our guides are also fully trained in water rescue and first aid. To guarantee we can assign an English-speaking guide to your specific tour, please let us know your language preference when you make your booking.
